thread:
Mike: FYI — we had a customer hit a bad path where an emergency override bumped a route quota but didn't expire. Need a short convo on console + API UX for overrides with TTL + audit.
Sara: ugh, heard about that. Do we know which endpoint set the override? front-end or infra API?
Mike: Looks like console-created override. No TTL set in UI; backend accepted null and stored forever.
Ying: We should enforce a default TTL on server-side for console overrides (e.g. 1h) and require explicit confirmation to make it permanent. :warning:
Jordan: Agree on default TTL. Also add an audit flag on the override record: created_by, source, expires_at, original_config.
PM-Sam: From product POV we need visible expiration in the console list and an ability to extend with 2-step confirmation. Users hit this because they wanted a quick ramp for a Canary and forgot to remove.
Devin: Implementation sketch: new API POST /v1/overrides with payload {route, delta_quota, ttl_secs, reason, source}, returns override_id. If ttl_secs omitted backend sets default_ttl.
Sara: Suggestion: reject ttl_secs > 30d unless account has special permission, to avoid accidental permanent changes.
Ying: Also add an "ephemeral" flag so infra can prioritise eviction if quota pressure hits.
Ops-bot: deploy-bot created deploy/infra/override-ttl-protections v1.1 — CI started
Mike: Telemetry: emit events override.created, override.extended, override.expired, override.deleted. Include fields: override_id, actor, source, route, ttl_secs, original_value, new_value.
Jordan: Dashboards: new panel for active overrides with age distribution and top authors. Add alert if >X active overrides across routes or >Y total additional tokens allowed by overrides.
PM-Sam: UX: in console show a subtle banner when an override is active on a route: "Override active (expires in 47m) — view / extend / revoke". Clicking extend opens a 2-step modal with audit reason required.
Devin: Edge case: what if an override is applied while a canary rollout is in progress? We need precedence rules. Proposal: overrides are applied at the evaluation layer after routing policies but before quotas; mark them as "temporary override" in routing trace so diagnosis is easy.
Sara: Implementation note: avoid coupling override logic into quota evaluation hot path. Instead return a delta token budget from an override cache that the evaluator merges in.
Ying: We need idempotency keys for the create API to avoid double-applies from retries. Use header X-Idempotency-Key.
Mike: Security: log KMS key id if override touched an encrypted config? probably not needed but keep audit consistent.
Jordan: Rollout plan: feature-flag the console UI + API validation server-side for 2 weeks. Dry-run mode where backend accepts overrides but marks them as inert for 24 hours (no effect) and show diff in console for owners.
PM-Sam: Dry-run will help get ops buy-in. Also we should add a CSV export of active overrides for SOC reviews.
Devin: Sample API call in thread:

```
POST /v1/overrides
Authorization: Bearer x
{
  "route": "route:embed-prod",
  "delta_quota": 2000,
  "ttl_secs": 3600,
  "reason": "short-term load test",
  "source": "console"
}
```

Response 201 {"override_id":"ovr_12345","expires_at":"2024-05-01T12:34:56Z"}

Sara: Ops concern: what if expiry happens during peak and we drop below SLA? We should support automated staggered expiry where we notify team 5m before expiry and optionally auto-extend by small increments with approval workflow.
Ying: We'll need tests: unit tests for ttl logic, integration test for idempotency + eviction, chaos test where override data store loses TTL and ensure fallback works.
Mike: Can we also make the override apply to a scoped cohort, not whole route? e.g., only session ids starting with 'beta-'
Jordan: Yep, scope field should accept cohort selectors (account_id, user_segment, header regex). Console will default to global but advanced allows cohort scope.
PM-Sam: Let's document the new flow in the runbook: how to create, how to revoke, monitoring pages, and a postmortem template if an override causes regressions.
Ops-bot: Reminder: added runbook link to #incidents: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/override-playbook
Devin: I'll open a PR for API + backend validation. Assign to @Ying for backend, @Sara for infra eval, @Jordan for console and dashboards. ETA EOW for PR draft.
Ying: ack. I'll prototype TTL enforcement and expiry job.
Sara: I'll wire the telemetry events and add dashboard panels.
Mike: Thanks all — priority P2 but let's move quickly. If anyone sees a runaway override in the meantime, revoke it and ping #oncall.
Jordan: noted. I'll mock the console modal designs and put in Figma.
PM-Sam: I'll draft the product doc and follow up with legal for audit requirements.
Devin: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/6789 (WIP)
Mike: closing the loop — will revisit after PR review. :thumbsup:
